bio: Connor Vaughn serves as Brass Caption Manager for the Crossmen Drum & Bugle Corps. An Indianapolis native and Butler University music education graduate, he marched trumpet with Carolina Crown in 2014 and 2015 before instructing brass with the Crossmen (2016-2018), the Mandarins, The Cadets, and The Cavaliers. He is the Head Band Director at McKinney North High School in Texas.

Dan Schmitt serves as Audio Caption Supervisor for The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps, of which he is a 2010 alumnus. He has spent more than a decade as an audio engineer in DCI, working with finalist percussion sections as well as champions in DCI, WGI, and Bands of America. He is Percussion Director at South Oldham High School in Crestwood, Kentucky and Lead Audio Engineer at Rhythm X.

David Glasgow was the Bluecoats' first full-time director, a former Bluecoats drum major and Bluecoat of the Year who became executive director in August 2003. Under his leadership from 2004 to 2018 the corps made DCI Finals every season, including five top-three finishes and the 2016 World Championship. He was twice named DCI Director of the Year (2006, 2014) and was inducted into the Bluecoats Hall of Fame in 2017.

David Lofy serves as Director of Programs for Forward Performing Arts and Corps Director of the Madison Scouts Drum and Bugle Corps, with whom he performed as a baritone player and drum major from 2012 to 2014. He taught the Oregon Crusaders Drum and Bugle Corps from 2015 to 2016 before rejoining the Scouts administratively in 2017. He holds a bachelor's in music education from UW-Eau Claire and a master's from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

Debbie Odello is a Blue Devils alumna from Concord, California and a longtime member of the BD Performing Arts organization. She has served in administrative roles with the Blue Devils across multiple seasons, including manager of the Blue Devils B open-class corps.

Eric Babula is a color guard designer and instructor who performed six seasons with The Cadets Drum and Bugle Corps before joining its color guard staff, serving as a designer and caption supervisor (roughly 2010-2015). Originally from Burlington, New Jersey, he also taught and designed for programs including Black Gold Winter Guard and Flower Mound High School, and serves as Director of Color Guard at Trumbull High School in Connecticut.
